{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-2","id":"msg_011Cgt5a9FGk2sMmquvUUQ7d","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017Y7Rm27LN5LDm9QoJ9a4qx","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/cli_tool.cpp <<'EOF'\n// MNIST inference: ./cli_tool weights.json image.png\n// Prints the predicted digit (0-9) for a 28x28 image.\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <string>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"cJSON.h\"\n#include \"lodepng.h\"\n\nstruct Linear {\n    int in = 0, out = 0;\n    std::vector<float> w;  // row-major, out x in\n    std::vector<float> b;\n};\n\nstatic bool read_file(const char *path, std::string &data) {\n    FILE *f = fopen(path, \"rb\");\n    if (!f) return false;\n    char buf[65536];\n    size_t n;\n    while ((n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) data.append(buf, n);\n    fclose(f);\n    return true;\n}\n\nstatic bool load_linear(const cJSON *root, const std::string &name, Linear &l) {\n    const cJSON *w = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, (name + \".weight\").c_str());\n    const cJSON *b = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, (name + \".bias\").c_str());\n    if (!cJSON_IsArray(w) || !cJSON_IsArray(b)) return false;\n    const cJSON *row, *v;\n    cJSON_ArrayForEach(row, w) {\n        if (!cJSON_IsArray(row)) return false;\n        int cols = 0;\n        cJSON_ArrayForEach(v, row) {\n            if (!cJSON_IsNumber(v)) return false;\n            l.w.push_back((float)v->valuedouble);\n            cols++;\n        }\n        if (l.out == 0) l.in = cols;\n        else if (cols != l.in) return false;\n        l.out++;\n    }\n    cJSON_ArrayForEach(v, b) {\n        if (!cJSON_IsNumber(v)) return false;\n        l.b.push_back((float)v->valuedouble);\n    }\n    return l.out > 0 && (int)l.b.size() == l.out;\n}\n\nstatic std::vector<float> forward(const Linear &l, const std::vector<float> &x, bool relu) {\n    std::vector<float> y(l.out);\n    for (int i = 0; i < l.out; i++) {\n        float s = l.b[i];\n        const float *row = &l.w[(size_t)i * l.in];\n        for (int j = 0; j < l.in; j++) s += row[j] * x[j];\n        y[i] = (relu && s < 0) ? 0 : s;\n    }\n    return y;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char **argv) {\n    if (argc != 3) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"usage: %s weights.json image.png\\n\", argv[0]);\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    std::string json;\n    if (!read_file(argv[1], json)) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot read %s\\n\", argv[1]);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    cJSON *root = cJSON_ParseWithLength(json.data(), json.size());\n    if (!root) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"error: %s is not valid JSON\\n\", argv[1]);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    Linear input, hidden, output;\n    if (!load_linear(root, \"input_layer\", input) ||\n        !load_linear(root, \"hidden_layer\", hidden) ||\n        !load_linear(root, \"output_layer\", output) ||\n        hidden.in != input.out || output.in != hidden.out) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"error: %s does not contain the expected model weights\\n\", argv[1]);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    cJSON_Delete(root);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;\n    unsigned width, height;\n    unsigned err = lodepng::decode(pixels, width, height, argv[2], LCT_GREY, 8);\n    if (err) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"error: cannot decode %s: %s\\n\", argv[2], lodepng_error_text(err));\n        return 1;\n    }\n    if ((size_t)width * height != (size_t)input.in) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"error: image is %ux%u, model expects %d pixels\\n\", width, height, input.in);\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    std::vector<float> x(pixels.size());\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pixels.size(); i++) x[i] = pixels[i] / 255.0f;\n\n    x = forward(input, x, true);\n    x = forward(hidden, x, true);\n    x = forward(output, x, false);\n\n    int best = 0;\n    for (int i = 1; i < (int)x.size(); i++)\n        if (x[i] > x[best]) best = i;\n    printf(\"%d\\n\", best);\n    return 0;\n}\nEOF\ncd /app && gcc -O2 -c cJSON.c -o /tmp/build/cJSON.o && g++ -O2 -c lodepng.cpp -o /tmp/build/lodepng.o && g++ -O2 -Wall -Wextra -c cli_tool.cpp -o /tmp/build/cli_tool.o && g++ -static -o cli_tool /tmp/build/cli_tool.o /tmp/build/cJSON.o /tmp/build/lodepng.o && ./cli_tool weights.json image.png","description":"Write and build cli_tool, run on sample image"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1166,"cache_read_input_tokens":21144,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1166,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"abe9f276-e00b-49d3-a543-b5992571f214","uuid":"9557a972-4edd-4ff2-8248-f0ca391412fe","timestamp":"2026-11-09T21:40:25.405Z","request_id":"req_011Cgt5a94MJmCjz6SxahYVF"}
